architecture_pattern.definition: Recurring arrangement of products, capabilities and mechanisms.

capability.definition: Typed operation offered under a semantic contract.

control_component.definition: Stateful or policy component inside a product boundary.

implementation.definition: Observed implementation or provider; unqualified until conformance evidence exists.

neighbor.definition: Explicit adjacent semantic or product owner imported through an ACL.

optional_extension.definition: Removable method or assistance surface that cannot redefine core semantics or authority.

product.definition: Independently adopted and operated outcome promise with lifecycle, authority, support and exit.

semantic_contract.definition: Owner of a term, identity, law, decision and refusal boundary.

standard.definition: Editioned external specification or profile; not a product or provider qualification.

suite.definition: Commercial or administrative packaging of products; owns no merged semantics.
